text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*shhhhh...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we were training, rain began to fall. 
The regimen is almost finished anyway, so 
here we should...
choice_data_list: Good work. Shall we finish up for today?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew...! ...Hmm, you have a point...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Who's that over there...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah— Hehe, ahaha! Yeah, just as I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This sound, this chill. It all feels so 
good... I feel like I could go anywhere 
just like this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A little rain is no problem! Let's 
keep going as far as we can, shall we!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Rain or storm, bring it on! When I'm in 
the groove, I'm totally invincible!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
O-Ooh! This painting... It really is 
wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um! Would it be alright if I went and 
trained just a little bit more!?
choice_data_list: Even with the weather this bad...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why! An Umamusume 
training furiously amidst the pouring 
rain. Even caked in mud, the fire in her 
eyes never fades—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aah...! Now that's a true hot-blooded 
protagonist, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little! Just a tiny bit is fine, 
so... what do you say!?"
choice_data_list: It'll be terrible if you catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little! Just a tiny bit is fine, 
so... what do you say!?"
choice_data_list: It'll be terrible if you catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer...! Yes, I'll train as hard as I 
can!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff*...! Heheh, this is it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kicking up mud and splashing water! We're 
just getting started~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmph...! T-That's true, isn't it~...
choice_data_list:
There must be other hot-blooded situations 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Ah, I see! In that case, let's see~..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about making victory charms? Like... 
praying for a win in the race and putting 
our determination into the charm!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, chatting with herself about 
classic hot-blooded sports anime moments, 
Kiseki wrapped up her training.
